reason: The plugin enforces a plan-first development workflow by automatically enabling plan mode, requiring user approval before implementation, and exempting non-development tasks through a dedicated tool.

summaries.zh: 该插件为开发任务自动启用计划模式，要求先提交并获批实施方案后再编码，同时允许非开发任务退出计划模式。
summaries.en: This plugin enforces a plan-first workflow for development tasks by enabling plan mode automatically, requiring approval before implementation, and allowing non-development tasks to exit plan mode.

capabilities: Automatically enables plan mode for new agent sessions
Augments plan-mode guidance and persona instructions
Exits plan mode for model-identified non-development tasks through a registered tool
